proxy_holdout.method: Leave one seed round out: select by mean relative fission-rate proxy in two rounds and evaluate in the held-out round.
proxy_holdout.interpretation: Descriptive ranking stability only. Same proxy is used for selection/evaluation, only three rounds exist, and physical validation is not certified.

frozen_decision_rule.rule: No winner unless independent model/tally review is signed off; model-appropriate acceptance criteria are justified from primary specifications before final ranking; uncertainty treatment is documented; and a candidate passes all predeclared criteria. Otherwise NO_SELECTION / INCONCLUSIVE.
frozen_decision_rule.reason_numeric_limits_null: No scientifically approved physical acceptance limits were found in the audited evidence; do not invent limits from observed outcomes.

remaining_blockers: Independent review of generated geometry/material/boundary inputs against the primary C5G7 specification.
Independent validation of mesh-to-assembly mapping and the relative fission-rate proxy against an appropriate reference tally.
Review source/eigenvalue stationarity and the large smoke-to-high-budget mean shifts; convergence is not certified.
Approve a justified physical acceptance rule and uncertainty handling before ranking.
Obtain comparable pre-physics QUBO objective scores and run a fair predeclared CB-PFR versus QUBO-only/simple-baseline evaluation.
nonclaims: No absolute power or flux validation
